positions.name: KnowledgeErasureDirectives
positions.frame: how is authority exercised when directing the removal of institutional knowledge?
positions.why: Both expressions are bare, unhedged imperatives ('Forget…', 'Remove…') issued in the same flat, matter-of-fact register and enacting authority through a unilateral command to discard what is known — one targeting a named decision, the other a named migration's knowledge. The dimensional reads mark both with the same register and relational signature (flat imperative, authority-ranking erasure command), so the two cohere as one directional read even though their objects differ.
